text: [calm, natural narrator voice] No: the long fit says growing; the late fit and finer grid, fading. This edge is known to about zero point one; the third, near twenty-seven, to about one. A likely cause, still unchecked: the modes oscillate, so the growth curve wobbles. The divergence, at least, stays at rounding error. That unresolved sign is where Bet one begins.
